description: Defines data structures and classes for representing, grouping, and managing certificate errors and warnings in a certificate validation process, including CertError, CertErrors, and CertPathErrors.

classes.name: CertError
classes.description: Represents an individual certificate error or warning, including severity, identifier, and optional parameters.

classes.name: CertErrors
classes.description: A collection of CertError objects, with methods to add, query, and debug errors.

classes.name: CertPathErrors
classes.description: A collection of CertErrors grouped by certificate in a chain, with methods to access errors per certificate and overall.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds an error or warning with specified severity, id, and optional parameters.

methods.name: AddError
methods.description: Adds a high severity error with specified id and optional parameters.

methods.name: AddWarning
methods.description: Adds a low severity warning with specified id and optional parameters.

methods.name: ToDebugString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the errors for debugging.

methods.name: ContainsError
methods.description: Checks if a specific error id exists in the collection.

methods.name: ContainsAnyErrorWithSeverity
methods.description: Checks if any errors of a given severity exist in the collection.

methods.name: GetErrorsForCert
methods.description: Retrieves or creates the error bucket for a specific certificate index.

methods.name: GetOtherErrors
methods.description: Retrieves errors not associated with any specific certificate.

methods.name: ContainsHighSeverityErrors
methods.description: Checks if there are any high severity errors.
